verdict.rationale: Snowflake's docs describe a credit-based compute model in which virtual warehouses consume credits as they run and users control that consumption directly. A pricing page lists editions starting with an entry-level Standard tier. A hands-on trial user mapped 9 credits plus 40GB of storage to about $19.60 and noted that credits double with each warehouse size, which suggests a bill can be estimated from the published model. However, the pack contains no actual per-credit or per-TB rates, no pricing calculator, and no documented sizing-to-credit table, so a reliable pre-commit monthly estimate is only partly supported. Missing for 10: published per-credit and storage rates in evidence, an official cost estimator or calculator, a documented warehouse-size credit table, and independent confirmation that estimates match actual bills.
